method: Two warm-ups per version and product; eight alternating paired deterministic 52-step replays, 416 timed substeps per version per product. Sample count fixed before this candidate run; previous failed attempt retained. Same performance thresholds: every ratio >0.95 and median product ratio >1.03. Meshing/startup/hash/skin excluded from solver timing. Phase profiles are separate and inclusive: do not add nested timings.
scope: CPU benchmark, not user device FPS. Node GC events, not browser GC. Browser queue/GPU attribution is separate or unavailable.
